extends: maritime-owner-discussion-stream/1.0.0-candidate.1; existing EventPage, Error, canonical records, event identities and cursor authority unchanged; transport only, no new canonical schema family

operation.limit: Canonical decimal1..50/default20, same independently retained resolved query value as terminal snapshot/changes cursor.
operation.cursor: Required issued changes cursor from terminal baseline or prior changes; query cursor or exactly one Last-Event-ID header. Both allowed only byte-identical. Never bearer in URL.
operation.accept: Absent or one exact text/event-stream header.

listener.construction: Explicit trusted-host TLS only; subclass shares issuer and delegates existing snapshot/changes routes unchanged on SAME listener.
listener.current_authority: Existing registry owner, Store coordinator, approved project, durable sole-owner room and explicit comms_read+comms_owner_discussion. No default/employee/remote-session authority.
listener.concurrency: At most4 handler connections by default, at most1 active SSE per stable owner per listener; host-owned bounded admission and cancellation, no public session registry.

host_only_options.send_buffer_bytes: Requested SO_SNDBUF4096..65536/default16384; OS may adjust actual kernel buffering. No query overrides.

response.body_framing: Close-delimited stream; no Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding.
response.utf8: Strict UTF8. LF field lines, blank LF terminator; data is one canonical JSON line with embedded control/newline text JSON-escaped.
response.keepalive_semantics: Active connection only; no id/domain event/receipt/ACK/progress/model trigger/cursor advancement. No idle EventPage. A due comment is deferred when a legally full data queue has insufficient room; pending data already keeps the stream active and authorization still rechecks.
response.changes_frame:
id: <data.next_cursor>
event: changes
data: <canonical existing EventPage>
response.control_frame:
event: control
data: <canonical existing closed Error>

reuse.payload: Existing complete EventPage and closed Error from frozen stream.schema.json; no EventItem-only alternate validator.
reuse.cursor: SSEid equals payload.next_cursor, scoped opaque replay position NOT canonical publicevent UUID. Public IDs/revisions/producer/ref/digests are unchanged inside payload.
reuse.validation: Existing Gen validateOwnerDiscussionChanges then projectOwnerDiscussionChanges, retained company/project/query/snapshot/lastappliedcursor. Advance only after a COMPLETE validated/applied frame; never from partially received id line.
reuse.overlap: Old cursor replay can overlap and observe a new committed tail. Identical stable domain eventID/revision/digest applies once; conflicts fail. Replay never invokes append/action/approval/task/model.
reuse.trim: Use longest whole EventItem prefix whose ENTIRE framed EventPage fits65536. Recompute page.range/caught_up/next_cursor/coverage/digest using same authenticated cut and committed observed upper. Existing DTO max_response262144 remains an upperbound; SSE has stricter framed cap.
reuse.truncation: If shorter than source replaypage, byte_limit against SSE framing cap. Never claim item_limit below retainedquerylimit. Preserve sourcecoverage when untrimmed. No splitting/dropping/position advance past unread records.
reuse.single_item_too_large: No emission/advancement; terminal RESYNC_REQUIRED/EOF. Received RESYNC_REQUIRED requires an explicit fresh complete snapshot. EOF alone permits explicit reopen/JSON catch-up from the last retained valid cursor; never bypass a received resync or change provider.

bounds.outstanding_accounting: Unsent queue plus remaining in-flight frame; no unbounded buffered wfile body writes. This is not total process RSS; bounded replay materialization and TLS/OS socket buffers are separate.
bounds.write_stall_semantics: Fixed per-frame completion deadline, not extended by small/drip writes. Overflow or stalled reader disconnects without consuming ledger/cursors.
bounds.network_transactions: No Store transaction/service lease/registry operation held across socket writes, waits or client drain. Handler owns its SQLite connection and closes it on all exit paths.

access_and_terminal.opening: Before response200 validate current authorization and existing changes cursor/anchors/expiry through existing authority.
access_and_terminal.live: Recheck current registry+Store/project/soleowner/effectiveaccess/cursor expiry periodically while idle and before frame/partial writes. Drop queued protected payloads when denied/stale.
access_and_terminal.before_headers: Existing closed HTTP400/401/403/404/409/410/503 error DTOs; oldJSONroutes unchanged.
access_and_terminal.after_headers: Best-effort bounded control frame with existing closed error code then EOF, no id, ONLY at a completed frame boundary. During a partial frame, or when writer is blocked, close EOF without splicing control bytes. Client discards incomplete frame and retains last complete cursor. Bytes already transmitted cannot be recalled.
access_and_terminal.reconnect: Explicit caller action only, no client auto-poll/reconnect. On EOF retain last FULLY validated/applied cursor and independently permitted scope/query; explicit reopen may replay overlap.
access_and_terminal.resync: HTTP409/410 or terminal RESYNC_REQUIRED requires explicit fresh snapshot; no hidden reset/splice. Authdenial withdraws sensitive access; cursor possession does not authorize.
access_and_terminal.cancellation: Client abort closes its connection. Host server close cancels/closes active sockets and joins owned handlers; no remote stop route, model or employee wake.

lifecycle: Existing fixed snapshot wall+monotonic expiry, current-access bindings, listener incarnation and stopped/offline-restore/fresh-issuer limitations unchanged. Alive-issuer restore and unobserved accessABA remain unsupported.
consumer_task: Smallest explicit-open/abort trusted-owner Gen streaming client. Parse bounded complete frames and reuse existing catch-up validation/projection; test one disposable verified-TLS round-trip. No UI/SSE browser gateway, remote owner sessions, new store/cache, automatic reconnect or polling.
asset_scope: No new canonical runtime schema asset required; existing EventPage/Error imports suffice. If a consumer actually imports this descriptor at runtime, coordinate exact asset with personal Gen owner only after importer terminal.

golden_vectors.recipe: id: page.next_cursor LF event: changes LF data: C01canonical(page) LF LF; no data copy/new event identity
